title: Namesake Select
description: Stops “right name, wrong person” picks (the second Ravi Kumar one row down, a patient or customer with a twin) by flagging options that share a name regardless of case, accents or word order with only the details that tell them apart, asking for one identifier among the namesakes before a shared name becomes the value (the ID re-entry that cut wrong-patient orders most in a randomized trial), offering a one-tap switch when the answer belongs to the other person, reading the choice back with two identifiers and calling out identical records as likely duplicates, in a list that flips and shrinks instead of clipping.
stops: Right name picked for wrong person
